messages:
Ravi Desai: Quick heads up: USW2 thermal batch alerted on shelf-3 around 22:02. Looks like a new tenant doing heavy KV prefetch + long-context decoding on a fractional-dedicated slice. Other tenants on that shelf hit 2x tail latency.

Olivia Wang: grabbing logs. infra shows NIC queue Q1 saturated, hbm usage climbing to 94%. Can we soft-fence?

InfraBot: ALERT shelf-3: GPU temp 85C, nic_tx 1.05GB/s, kv_evictions +480%. Ticket INC-9331 created.

Marco Lopez: any recent config changes?

Ravi Desai: none. Tenant is tid-3339 (search microbench). They don't have dedicated capacity.

Jules Park: propose this quick workaround: reduce tenant batch_size and enforce kv_prefetch_cold_only. We have an api: `tenantctl throttle --tenant=tid-3339 --batch=8 --prefetch=idle`.

Olivia Wang: run it. Also set shelf-level nic_shaper to 900MB/s while we assess.

Ravi Desai: doing both now.

InfraBot: ACTION: tenant policy applied. shelf nic_shaper set to 900MB/s.

(45s) Olivia Wang: telemetry: egress down 40%, thermal plateau at 78C. tail p95 improved ~30%. KV evictions dropping slowly.

Marco Lopez: next step: if this tenant repeats 3x in a 24h window, auto-enforce a carveout with billing notification and migration window. We should also update allocation strategy to prefer spreading prefetch-heavy tenants across racks.

Jules Park: yes, also add a small doc note to dev portal: "Best-effort prefetching only on shared shelves; for sustained prefetch use dedicated slices."

Ravi Desai: created ticket OPS-713 to add automation.

Olivia Wang: marking tid-3339 for review. Closing once 30m stable. :thumbsup:
